### 3 Anchors to Keep You Afloat in Any Storm
Author: Carolyn Dale Newell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-october-23-2017.html
Passage: Matthew 14:27
Points:
- Believers can face frightening storms even while directly obeying Christ's will.
- God directs our circumstances through providence, working His purpose through the storm.
- Jesus personally enters our distress so that we never endure suffering alone.
- Christ holds supreme authority and power to calm any tempest with His word.

### Risk and Failure
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-may-21-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 14:22
Points:
- Jesus sent the disciples into the crossing to protect them from dangerous worldly ambition.
- Staring at Jesus rather than circumstances imparts the courage needed to take bold steps.
- Peter asked the Lord for permission before stepping out instead of acting presumptuously.
- Although Peter faltered, he demonstrated real faith by daring to leave the boat.
- Attempting great things for God and stumbling is better than never taking a step of faith.
